native.source: current native source() fixture / private diagnostic baseline in inputs/selection-cost-baseline.cpp
selection_regions: sparse bounding-box overlap without true intersection
native.matrix: Do not full-cartesian all sizes. 1/8/16/32 dense7199/two histories core; other sizes/history counts sampled in focused correctness/property corpus. Include one independent content body and mask/transform/Undo fork.

normal_web.safety_dpr4_note: Explicit bounded-dimension recovery/correctness, not full desktop DPR4 performance.
normal_web.fixture_rule: Use identical opaque baseline snapshots/resources or generate once through existing public input then hash-freeze. Capture metadata from existing catalog. Never build candidate stroke geometry in JS or mutate a user demo.
required_sequences: Restore dense erased S2 -> place rectangle -> blank point-tool mouse Down/Move drag -> Up -> immediately fresh Down/Up; separate Cancel, lostpointercapture/source-lost and pointer ID reuse controls.
Existing partial erase -> Up -> same-task next Down without waiting for receipt or settle -> next erase -> Up; another case Up -> immediate wheel pan/zoom; final Undo/Redo.
32-copy native safety and DPR4 bounded display recovery are native; primary Web uses matched16-copy S0/S2 plus19-line trace reconstruction only if needed to reproduce selection entry.

Read state/selection/final document/qualified receipt after timed input. Readbacks/snapshots only outside primary timing. Cancel produces no Operation; exactly one erase Operation per non-noop Up; no-op changes neither document nor History.
normal_web.pacing: Actual DOM events / public SDK. Immediately means next task opportunity or <=one refresh period; never await settle between Up and subsequent action. Record planned time/handler start/end and event lateness. Initial fixture warm-up and final correctness settling are separate.

baseline_rules: Freeze old selection callable/kernel or binary and unchanged CPU exact/component oracle before production edit. Hash baseline ordinary SDK/assets. No relabel/rebuild baseline as candidate; record r2 dirty source identity.
classification: Local performance observations with exact independent correctness; no physical input-to-photon or general SLO claim.
